1.web: The beginning of the Good News of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.
1.asv: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.

2.web: As it is written in the prophets, “Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.
2.asv: Even as it is written in Isaiah the prophet, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, Who shall prepare thy way;

3.web: The voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make ready the way of the Lord! Make his paths straight!’”
3.asv: The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make ye ready the way of the Lord, Make his paths straight;

4.web: John came baptizing in the wilderness and preaching the baptism of repentance for forgiveness of sins.
4.asv: John came, who baptized in the wilderness and preached the baptism of repentance unto remission of sins.

5.web: All the country of Judea and all those of Jerusalem went out to him. They were baptized by him in the Jordan river, confessing their sins.
5.asv: And there went out unto him all the country of Judæa, and all they of Jerusalem; and they were baptized of him in the river Jordan, confessing their sins.

6.web: John was clothed with camel’s hair and a leather belt around his waist. He ate locusts and wild honey.
6.asv: And John was clothed with camel’s hair, and had a leathern girdle about his loins, and did eat locusts and wild honey.

7.web: He preached, saying, “After me comes he who is mightier than I, the thong of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and loosen.
7.asv: And he preached, saying, There cometh after me he that is mightier than I, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose.

8.web: I baptized you in water, but he will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.”
8.asv: I baptized you in water; but he shall baptize you in the Holy Spirit.

9.web: In those days, Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized by John in the Jordan.
9.asv: And it came to pass in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized of John in the Jordan.

10.web: Immediately coming up from the water, he saw the heavens parting, and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.
10.asv: And straightway coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens rent asunder, and the Spirit as a dove descending upon him:

11.web: A voice came out of the sky, “You are my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”
11.asv: and a voice came out of the heavens, Thou art my beloved Son, in thee I am well pleased.

12.web: Immediately the Spirit drove him out into the wilderness.
12.asv: And straightway the Spirit driveth him forth into the wilderness.

13.web: He was there in the wilderness forty days tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals; and the angels were serving him.
13.asv: And he was in the wilderness forty days tempted of Satan; and he was with the wild beasts; and the angels ministered unto him.

14.web: Now after John was taken into custody, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the Good News of the Kingdom of God,
14.asv: Now after John was delivered up, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of God,

15.web: and saying, “The time is fulfilled, and the Kingdom of God is at hand! Repent, and believe in the Good News.”
15.asv: and saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe in the gospel.

16.web: Passing along by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew the brother of Simon casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.
16.asv: And passing along by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew the brother of Simon casting a net in the sea; for they were fishers.

17.web: Jesus said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you into fishers for men.”
17.asv: And Jesus said unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.

18.web: Immediately they left their nets, and followed him.
18.asv: And straightway they left the nets, and followed him.

19.web: Going on a little further from there, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John, his brother, who were also in the boat mending the nets.
19.asv: And going on a little further, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the boat mending the nets.

20.web: Immediately he called them, and they left their father, Zebedee, in the boat with the hired servants, and went after him.
20.asv: And straightway he called them: and they left their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired servants, and went after him.

21.web: They went into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught.
21.asv: And they go into Capernaum; and straightway on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught.

22.web: They were astonished at his teaching, for he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.
22.asv: And they were astonished at his teaching: for he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.

23.web: Immediately there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit, and he cried out,
23.asv: And straightway there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit; and he cried out,

24.web: saying, “Ha! What do we have to do with you, Jesus, you Nazarene? Have you come to destroy us? I know you who you are: the Holy One of God!”
24.asv: saying, What have we to do with thee, Jesus thou Nazarene? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of God.

25.web: Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be quiet, and come out of him!”
25.asv: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him.

26.web: The unclean spirit, convulsing him and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.
26.asv: And the unclean spirit, tearing him and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.

27.web: They were all amazed, so that they questioned among themselves, saying, “What is this? A new teaching? For with authority he commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey him!”
27.asv: And they were all amazed, insomuch that they questioned among themselves, saying, What is this? a new teaching! with authority he commandeth even the unclean spirits, and they obey him.

28.web: The report of him went out immediately everywhere into all the region of Galilee and its surrounding area.
28.asv: And the report of him went out straightway everywhere into all the region of Galilee round about.

29.web: Immediately, when they had come out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
29.asv: And straightway, when they were come out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.

30.web: Now Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick with a fever, and immediately they told him about her.
30.asv: Now Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick of a fever; and straightway they tell him of her:

31.web: He came and took her by the hand, and raised her up. The fever left her, and she served them.
31.asv: and he came and took her by the hand, and raised her up; and the fever left her, and she ministered unto them.

32.web: At evening, when the sun had set, they brought to him all who were sick, and those who were possessed by demons.
32.asv: And at even, when the sun did set, they brought unto him all that were sick, and them that were possessed with demons.

33.web: All the city was gathered together at the door.
33.asv: And all the city was gathered together at the door.

34.web: He healed many who were sick with various diseases, and cast out many demons. He didn’t allow the demons to speak, because they knew him.
34.asv: And he healed many that were sick with divers diseases, and cast out many demons; and he suffered not the demons to speak, because they knew him.

35.web: Early in the morning, while it was still dark, he rose up and went out, and departed into a deserted place, and prayed there.
35.asv: And in the morning, a great while before day, he rose up and went out, and departed into a desert place, and there prayed.

36.web: Simon and those who were with him followed after him;
36.asv: And Simon and they that were with him followed after him;

37.web: and they found him, and told him, “Everyone is looking for you.”
37.asv: and they found him, and say unto him, All are seeking thee.

38.web: He said to them, “Let’s go elsewhere into the next towns, that I may preach there also, because I came out for this reason.”
38.asv: And he saith unto them, Let us go elsewhere into the next towns, that I may preach there also; for to this end came I forth.

39.web: He went into their synagogues throughout all Galilee, preaching and casting out demons.
39.asv: And he went into their synagogues throughout all Galilee, preaching and casting out demons.

40.web: A leper came to him, begging him, kneeling down to him, and saying to him, “If you want to, you can make me clean.”
40.asv: And there cometh to him a leper, beseeching him, and kneeling down to him, and saying unto him, If thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.

41.web: Being moved with compassion, he stretched out his hand, and touched him, and said to him, “I want to. Be made clean.”
41.asv: And being moved with compassion, he stretched forth his hand, and touched him, and saith unto him, I will; be thou made clean.

42.web: When he had said this, immediately the leprosy departed from him, and he was made clean.
42.asv: And straightway the leprosy departed from him, and he was made clean.

43.web: He strictly warned him, and immediately sent him out,
43.asv: And he strictly charged him, and straightway sent him out,

44.web: and said to him, “See you say nothing to anybody, but go show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing the things which Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”
44.asv: and saith unto him, See thou say nothing to any man: but go show thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing the things which Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.

45.web: But he went out, and began to proclaim it much, and to spread about the matter, so that Jesus could no more openly enter into a city, but was outside in desert places: and they came to him from everywhere.
45.asv: But he went out, and began to publish it much, and to spread abroad the matter, insomuch that Jesus could no more openly enter into a city, but was without in desert places: and they came to him from every quarter.
